solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Fruity preserves for coppers

parts.note: fruity talk is risqué or smutty, which is blue
to bottle fruit is to preserve it, so preserves (verb) gives bottles

explanation.surface: A jar of jam is sold as something suitable for police officers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fruity preserves' reads as jam; 'preserves' is really a verb, giving BOTTLES.
explanation.definitionFit: Bluebottles is old British slang for police officers, from their blue uniforms.

clue.text: Fellow that's titled Oscar in 'Hair'

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for Oscar is placed inside the word for hair

parts.note: barnet is Cockney rhyming slang for hair (Barnet Fair)
O is Oscar in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone with a title appears in the musical Hair.
explanation.walkthrough: BARNET is Cockney rhyming slang: 'Barnet Fair' rhymes with hair. 'Hair' in quotes looks like the musical.
explanation.definitionFit: A baronet holds a hereditary British title ranking below a baron, so he is a titled fellow.

clue.text: God from holy book — leader to overlook us

indicators.note: to overlook the leader is to skip the first letter of the word for holy book

parts.note: the Quran is the holy book of Islam

explanation.surface: A deity is drawn from scripture, with its head instructed to ignore us.
explanation.definitionFit: Uranus was the Greek primordial god of the sky, father of the Titans.

clue.text: Potential cause of downfall in cuckoo family

parts.note: cuckoo means crazy, as does bananas
kin means family or relatives

explanation.surface: A mad family could bring about someone's ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: A discarded fruit peel is the classic slapstick slipping hazard, and figuratively anything that trips someone up.

clue.text: Cylinder cut potato, perhaps

indicators.note: cut tells us the word is trimmed, losing its final letter

parts.note: a potato is an example of a tuber, hence perhaps

explanation.surface: A cylindrical piece is cut from a potato.
explanation.definitionFit: A tube is a long hollow cylinder, like a pipe.

clue.text: Theme park on old dock

parts.note: in cricket the on side is also called the leg side
an aircraft or spacecraft docking comes to land, so dock can mean land

explanation.surface: An amusement park has been built on a disused dockside.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the on side and the leg side are the same half of the field, so 'on' gives LEG.
explanation.definitionFit: Legoland is a chain of amusement resorts built around the toy brick brand.

clue.text: Tower initially positioned in metal base

indicators.note: in places the opening letter of positioned within the word for metal

parts.note: steel is a metal alloy

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of positioned

parts.note: e is the base of natural logarithms in mathematics

explanation.surface: A tower is first set up on a metal foundation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'base' looks like a foundation, but it is the mathematical constant e.
explanation.definitionFit: A church spire with its tower is a steeple, a tall pointed structure.

clue.text: Length of clip changed for cinema's third screen

indicators.note: changed for means one letter is swapped out and another letter substituted in its place

parts.note: to clip is to cut short, curtail

indicators.note: third picks the third letter of cinema

explanation.surface: A film clip's length is altered to suit the third screen at a multiplex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Length of clip' looks like a film duration; it is L inside the word for clip, swapped for N.
explanation.definitionFit: A curtain is a hanging screen used to shut out light or view.

clue.text: Officer shelled dome on keep after Washington's minor reassurance

indicators.note: after says the shelled dome and keep come later than the Washington letters
on in a down clue puts the shelled dome above the word for keep

parts.note: Col is the abbreviation for colonel, an army officer
Washington DC is the US capital

indicators.note: shelled means the outer letters of dome are stripped away like a shell

parts.note: a keep is the stronghold of a castle, a fort

explanation.surface: An officer bombards a dome and fort in the US capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Cold comfort is an idiom for consolation that does little to help, a minor reassurance.

clue.text: Personal problem is fault exposed in discussion

parts.note: a bug is a fault, as in software

indicators.note: in discussion means the word is spoken, so a word of the same sound is used

parts.note: exposed means bare, uncovered

explanation.surface: Someone's trouble is a flaw revealed during talks.
explanation.definitionFit: A bugbear is a persistent source of annoyance or a pet hate.

clue.text: Sent home a treat arranged with pride

indicators.note: arranged signals that the letters are reordered into a new word

explanation.surface: Someone is sent back to their country with a proud farewell treat.
explanation.definitionFit: To repatriate is to return a person to their native country.

clue.text: Note, going round Siena, grub regularly seen?

definitions.text: Note, going round Siena, grub regularly seen?

indicators.note: going round means the word for note wraps around the other letters

parts.note: a note is a short letter, a line

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter, here the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: A visitor to Siena observes the local food that is often seen there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes alternate letters across both words; 'going round' splits the note word after its first letter. The whole clue also describes the pasta as everyday Italian grub.
explanation.definitionFit: Linguine is a flat ribbon pasta, a staple food commonly eaten in Italian cities.

clue.text: Sumptuous drink consumed by another

indicators.note: consumed by means one drink is taken inside the other

parts.note: another drink: to sup is to sip or drink
to lap is to drink as a cat does

explanation.surface: A luxurious drink is swallowed by someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: A slap-up meal is a lavish, generous one, a British informal term for sumptuous.

clue.text: Handle bend on lake in small vessel

indicators.note: on in a down clue means the next piece follows in sequence

parts.note: to finger something is to handle it
to bow is to bend forward

explanation.surface: Handling a small boat means bending over a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A finger bowl is a small dish of water for rinsing fingers at table; vessel means container.

clue.text: Name and location reported

indicators.note: reported means the word is heard, so a same-sounding word is used

parts.note: a site is a location

explanation.surface: A name and a place have been reported.
explanation.definitionFit: To cite someone is to name or mention them, as in a citation.

clue.text: Worker admits messing about in task

indicators.note: admits means the word for worker lets other letters inside it

parts.note: the ant is the crossword's standard worker insect

indicators.note: about signals the letters of messing are moved around

explanation.surface: An employee lets slacking creep into a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges messing, and 'admits' places the result after the worker's first letter; 'in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An assignment is a piece of work allotted to someone, a task.

clue.text: D.H. Lawrence with such glee makes version of The Railway Children

indicators.note: makes version of says the letters of the book title are a rearrangement of the other two parts together

explanation.surface: D.H. Lawrence gleefully rewrites a children's classic.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of DH LAWRENCE plus the answer, together, rearrange into THE RAILWAY CHILDREN; 'such' refers to the answer itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Hilarity is great merriment or amusement, a synonym for glee.

clue.text: Doubts generous girl represses

indicators.note: represses means the word for girl holds the other word down inside it

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young woman
giving means generous

explanation.surface: A girl hides her uncertainties despite being generous.
explanation.definitionFit: Misgivings are feelings of doubt or apprehension.

clue.text: Like 2 seconds with cipher to crack

indicators.note: to crack means the letters of cipher are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A code is cracked in a couple of seconds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Like 2' points at the god-and-planet answer at 2 down: the planet is round.
explanation.definitionFit: Spheric means ball-shaped, as a planet is.

clue.text: Occasionally missing, wetsuit container

indicators.note: occasionally missing means some letters, every third one here, are left out of wetsuit

explanation.surface: A wetsuit has gone missing now and then from its bag.
explanation.definitionFit: An etui is a small ornamental case for needles or cosmetics.

clue.text: Labour: Tory oddly ready, but not able

indicators.note: oddly takes the first and third letters of Tory
but not means the word able is taken off the word for ready

parts.note: ready means available, to hand

explanation.surface: A political line: the Conservative is keen but incapable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' and 'Tory' suggest party politics; Labour is the definition, meaning toil.
explanation.definitionFit: Travail means painful or laborious effort, hard work.

clue.text: Selection of parts ordered up in stages

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the letters read from bottom to top
selection of means a run of letters is taken from inside parts ordered

explanation.surface: A selection of theatre roles is arranged in stages.
explanation.definitionFit: Rostra are raised platforms for speakers, plural of rostrum.

clue.text: Working hard, take food that's prepared to mate

parts.note: on means working, as a machine that is switched on
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
to eat is to take food

explanation.surface: After working hard, someone eats a meal that's ready for a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mate' looks like a friend; it is the verb to breed.
explanation.definitionFit: A female animal in oestrus, receptive to breeding, is said to be on heat.

clue.text: Sailor nearly lost gold aboard craft

indicators.note: aboard means placed inside the word for craft, as on a vessel

parts.note: craft means skill, art

indicators.note: nearly means drop the last letter

parts.note: lost means gone
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A seaman nearly lost treasure kept on his ship.
explanation.definitionFit: The Argonauts were the crew who sailed with Jason on the Argo seeking the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: First letter falls in transparent clue

indicators.note: in a down entry the first letter dropping means it moves from the top to the bottom

parts.note: thin, as in a thin excuse, means transparent

explanation.surface: In a transparent puzzle the opening letter gives a clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A hint is a slight clue or suggestion.

clue.text: Concerning time backfiring, car stops

indicators.note: backfiring means the letters run backwards

parts.note: re means concerning, about
the Mini is a classic small British car

explanation.surface: A car backfiring over time eventually stalls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backfiring' and 'car' suggest an engine; it signals reversing RE and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Termini are end stations or terminal stops on a transport line.

clue.text: Apparent way to escape conflict with daughter

parts.note: a way out is an escape route
war is conflict

explanation.surface: Someone seeks a route out of a family quarrel with their daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: Outward means visible on the surface, as in outward appearance, so apparent.

clue.text: Source of global vision?

parts.note: the fortune teller's sphere is global in shape, and its visions are seen in the round glass

explanation.surface: Something that offers a worldwide view.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortune teller gazes into a glass sphere to see visions of the future.
